digest.component_or_area: development process audit evaluation and recommendation disposition
propositions: Six development-process recommendations from the bleakish-stational-cob frozen audit (escaped-defect metadata, deterministic plan preflight, completion-failure classification, risk-tiered review, proactive code-debt management, and autonomous governance) must be evaluated against prior audits, janitor work, architecture decisions, and implementation outcomes before converting to new work.

Prior decisions and their rationale, observed outcomes or unresolved limitations, new evidence from the frozen 2026-08-15 audit, and material caveats must be explicitly documented with exact ticket aliases and semantic links so future work can recover context without repeating the audit.
Each recommendation must be assigned a supported disposition—reaffirm, refine, reconsider, or defer—with changed direction identifying the new evidence that warrants reconsideration.

Five of the six recommendations are refined by narrowing scope, correcting false premises, or acknowledging existing shipped implementations (detected_by present-only capture, P1-P11 deterministic floor, durable FAIL sidecars with structured findings, risk reporting without enforcement, and 720-LOC soft warning already deployed).

The sixth recommendation (maintainership/reviewer breadth) is heavily refined because the project's contribution process is autonomous with no mandatory human Gerrit review, so governance focus must shift to autonomous-assurance independence, provider diversity, and operational continuity rather than human approval or rotation.

Material gaps remain: true bug escape rate unavailable, prospective risk-tier validation incomplete, author-model independence from reviewer models not currently auditable, force/override frequency not quantified, no incident/SLO evidence on cadence impact, and complete governance/succession documentation not demonstrated.
